title: Enterprise Cloud-Native Kubernetes Gateway API Inference Extension (InferencePool + EPP) & llm-d KV/LoRA-Aware Routing

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Standard Kubernetes Service / L4-L7 Round-Robin Ingress
tiers.architecture: Default kube-proxy / Envoy Round-Robin across vLLM/SGLang pods without KV-cache, queue, or LoRA awareness

tiers.tier: Tier 2: HTTP Least-Connections + CPU/Memory HPA Ingress
tiers.architecture: Routing by active HTTP TCP stream count + standard CPU/Memory HPA (blind to token prompt length and GPU HBM KV saturation)

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Client-Side Consistent-Hash Sticky Tenant Routing
tiers.architecture: Static hash ring pinning tenant/session IDs to fixed pods (high prefix hit rate under light load, but severe hot-pod queue stalls under burst)

tiers.tier: Tier 4: K8s Gateway API Inference Extension (InferencePool + EPP) + llm-d KV/LoRA Composite Scorer + 3-Band Criticality Shedder
tiers.architecture: Envoy ext_proc Endpoint Picker (EPP) scoring real-time Pod KV-Cache % + Waiting Queue Depth + KV Block-Hash/LoRA Affinity + Critical/Standard/Sheddable Admission Gate

scenarios.scenario: Asymmetric 64K Long-Context Request vs. 512-Token Chat Request on Least-Connections Ingress
scenarios.question: Pod A has 2 active 64K-token RAG requests (94% HBM KV full); Pod B has 8 active 256-token chats (12% HBM KV used); route incoming 32K request
scenarios.model_answer: Envoy ext_proc Endpoint Picker (EPP) queries real-time vLLM KV-cache usage (94% vs 12%) and routes to Pod B, preventing HBM KV preemption swap on Pod A
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 Least-Connections sees 2 < 8 connections and routes the 32K request to Pod A, triggering immediate HBM KV eviction/recompute and a 4.48s TTFT spike.

scenarios.scenario: Multi-Turn Agent Shared 24K Prefix Routing Without Hot-Pod Queue Saturation
scenarios.question: Route 180 concurrent agent turns sharing a 24K system+repo prefix across an 8-pod vLLM V1 InferencePool
scenarios.model_answer: Compute composite EPP score S = w_prefix * PrefixBlockMatch(pod) - w_kv * KV_Util(pod) - w_q * QueueDepth(pod); overflow cleanly to secondary warm replica when primary queue > 5
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 Round-Robin scatters turns across all 8 pods (16.5% cache hit, 8x redundant prefill FLOPs); Tier 3 sticky hash pins all 180 turns to 1 pod (1,450ms queue stall).

scenarios.scenario: Dynamic Multi-LoRA Adapter Affinity Routing (`InferenceModel` CRD)
scenarios.question: Serve 48 fine-tuned departmental LoRA adapters across an 8-node H100 InferencePool without PCIe adapter thrashing
scenarios.model_answer: Match `InferenceModel` target adapter name against EPP live pod LoRA residency bitmap; route to pods with adapter already pinned in HBM/Pinned-DRAM (89.4% hit rate)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1/2 random routing forces every pod to continuously load/evict all 48 LoRA adapters over PCIe/disk, adding 380ms cold-adapter stalls.

scenarios.scenario: Pool-Wide 85% KV Saturation Burst & Criticality-Based Shedding (`Critical` vs. `Sheddable`)
scenarios.question: Batch document-summarization job floods the InferencePool and pushes cluster-wide KV utilization above 85% while live customer Copilot traffic arrives
scenarios.model_answer: Enforce `InferenceModel` criticality bands: immediately shed/defer `Sheddable` batch traffic at >=85% pool KV watermark while guaranteeing `Critical` interactive traffic (0.1% SLO breach)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1–3 FIFO admission lets low-priority batch jobs fill 100% of HBM KV blocks, causing 22.4% SLO breaches on live customer-facing Copilot requests.

key_findings: Tier 4 (Kubernetes Gateway API Inference Extension `InferencePool` + Envoy `ext_proc` Endpoint Picker `EPP` + `llm-d` KV/LoRA Composite Scorer) cuts P99 TTFT from 4,480 ms to 340 ms (-92.4%) and raises prefix/LoRA cache hit rate from 16.5% to 89.4%.
Traditional L4/L7 Round-Robin and HTTP Least-Connections load balancers are blind to request token length and GPU HBM KV saturation, causing 8.6%–14.8% KV preemption/OOM drops.

Enforcing `InferenceModel` 3-band criticality admission shedding (`Critical`, `Standard`, `Sheddable`) at the 85% pool KV watermark reduces critical-tier SLO breaches from 22.4% to 0.1% and lowers monthly GPU cluster TCO from $148K to $54K (-63.5%).
